projects.title: Shepherd's hut build
projects.description: Designed, built and situated from scratch, with corrugated steel cladding, hardwood doors and steps, a tongue-and-groove interior, kitchen, shower room and bedroom.

projects.title: Flat renovation
projects.description: A full refresh: new kitchen, retiled bathroom, new flooring and doors, and a panelled coat and shoe nook in the hallway.

projects.title: Balcony balustrade
projects.description: New timber posts, rails and capping built around the original decorative ironwork panels.

projects.title: Entrance porch
projects.description: A new porch framed up, sheathed and rendered, with a new front door and window.

projects.title: Garage rebuild
projects.description: The old block garage replaced with a new timber-framed building, rendered and clad, under a new roof.

projects.title: Hit and miss fencing
projects.description: A long run of hit and miss fencing on steel posts along a lane boundary, with new timber garden gates.

projects.title: Roof & chimney repairs
projects.description: A roof opened up to replace rotten timbers, and a chimney stack ready for repair.

projects.title: Rendered garden walls
projects.description: New retaining walls and steps, built and rendered.
